steps.en: OCMS pulls the classified vehicle list every day
steps.id: OCMS menarik daftar classified vehicle setiap hari

steps.en: The received vehicle numbers are saved in OCMS
steps.id: Nomor kendaraan yang diterima disimpan di OCMS

steps.en: The start and end date of each record is received and saved
steps.id: Tanggal mulai dan akhir tiap record diterima dan disimpan
steps.why_en: Only the vehicle number, description and status are read and saved; no dates.
steps.why_id: Hanya nomor kendaraan, deskripsi, dan status yang dibaca dan disimpan; tanpa tanggal.
